issue.title: bob projects list shows each project's open-prerequisite count and inline ^prj start date

task_type_fields.proposal: Add a 'waits on N' (open ^prj Depends-On prerequisites) and a start-date (^prj inline [scheduled::]) column to bob projects list human and JSON output. This replaces the projects-by-date view that frontmatter scheduled used to give Properties/Bases.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Out of scope for epic bob-cli-6u (plan:202610/prj_line_project_blocking.md lists it under Deliberately not doing / publish follow-ups); proposed by bob-cli-6u.17.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-6u.17 (note #4): with project dates and prerequisites back on the ^prj line, no list view shows them.
